fact: The Algerie Telecom chief executive said the group had finalised nearly 300,000 km of backbone fibre covering all wilayas, and that the backbone supplies the capacity mobile operators need.
title: Hichem Andaloussi, P-DG du Groupe Algérie Télécom, à Alger 16 : «L’Algérie, futur carrefour des données africaines»
